newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 25.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average shed 20.47 points to 6,792.25.
* The Malaysian blue-chip Composite Index fell 13.07 points, or 1.18 percent to 1,096.53.
* Analysts said Thursday's weaker close was accompanied by extremely thin volume, which was a positive sign that the market may be bottoming out. Volume stood at 176 million shares.
* Rumours of Renong acquiring a majority stake in loss-making National Steel Corp of the Philippines, dragged share prices of group companies lower.
* U.S. brokerage J.P. Morgan has cut its rating of Tanjong Plc to market underperformer from a buy. The downgrade was based on tough competition leading to slow earnings growth, said J.P. Morgan.

* "No one is going into this market because they all think they can buy cheaper. I think the lower volume yesterday does indicate a bottoming out," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage in Kuala Lumpur.
